decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar/Metagross with Metagross as intended Mega. Incineroar Fake Out disrupts Tailwind/Follow Me while Intimidate softens Arcanine/Dragonite physical hits. Mega Metagross with Tough Claws Meteor Mash pressures Gengar, Aerodactyl, and Empoleon. Mamoswine backline provides guaranteed Empoleon OHKO via Earthquake and Ice Shard priority for Dragonite. Hatterene offers Trick Room backup if Tailwind wins speed control. This lead pressures opponent's core while preserving Mamoswine from Hydro
decisions.notebook: Empoleon is opponent's primary win condition - must be pressured immediately with Water-resistant leads or Mamoswine EQ. Mega Gengar + Aerodactyl vulnerable to Incineroar Darkest Lariat and Mega Metagross Meteor Mash. Dragonite Lum Berry + Multiscale requires breaking Multiscale first before exploiting with priority. Tailwind is single-use; plan for speed disadvantage after early turns. Arcanine (Charcoal/Intimidate) and Clefable (Unaware/Follow Me) indicate pivot/redirect strategy protecting sweepers. Future leads must prioritize Water resistance or immediate Empoleon pressure. Mamoswine Life Orb Earthquake is reliable Empoleon removal but must avoid Hydro Pump/Flash Cannon exposure.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Gengar. Lead Empoleon + Aerodactyl to gain immediate turn-one pressure against Incineroar's Intimidate (+2 Competitive SpA) and deny spread damage with Wide Guard or set Tailwind. Backline Mega Gengar provides late-game speed, trapping, and special damage against Meowscarada, Hatterene, and Metagross, while Dragonite offers bulky physical finishing with Multiscale and ExtremeSpeed.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent confirmed moves/items: Mega Metagross (Protect, Ice Punch, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch), Incineroar (Fake Out, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz; Sitrus Berry), Rotom-Heat (Levitate, Leftovers, Thunderbolt, Overheat, Will-O-Wisp, Protect), Mamoswine (Life Orb, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Rock Slide, Protect).
Strategic facts: Empoleon quad-resists Mega Metagross's Steel/Ice attacks and activates Competitive against Incineroar.
Plan: Intended Mega is Gengar. Lead Empoleon + Aerodactyl to punish Incineroar leads and set Tailwind/Wide Guard, cleanup with Mega Gengar + Dragonite.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out on Aerodactyl prevents Rock Slide (2x on Incineroar) and Tailwind. Meteor Mash is 2x on Rock/Flying, breaking Focus Sash. Empoleon is free to attack but Incineroar's bulk + Sitrus can survive one Hydro Pump. Saving Mega for later Gengar matchup. Not Mega Evolving now since Focus Sash guarantees survival regardless of damage.
decisions.notebook: Empoleon Competitive into Intimidate = +2 SpA threat; must be pressured with Water-resistant leads or Mamoswine EQ. Aerodactyl Focus Sash + fast Tailwind/Rock Slide core. Preserve Mega Metagross for Mega Gengar (Shadow Tag) matchup. Opponent Tailwind is single-use. Arcanine Charcoal/Intimidate and Clefable Unaware/FollowMe indicate pivot/redirect strategy. Dragonite Lum+Multiscale requires breaking Multiscale first. Mamoswine Life Orb EQ reliable Empoleon removal but vulnerable to special attacks. Hatterene Trick Room option for speed control reversal.

decisions.rationale: Metagross cannot damage Empoleon effectively (7.9-17.6% NVE Meteor Mash). Mamoswine is 2x weak to Water and would be guaranteed OHKO'd by +2 SpA Hydro Pump. Hatterene takes neutral Water damage and has a survival chance (70.8-163.6% with +2 boost, not guaranteed). Switching Hatterene preserves Mamoswine for later Empoleon removal via Earthquake and enables Trick Room setup if Hatterene survives.
decisions.notebook: Empoleon Competitive into Intimidate creates +2 SpA threat - must respect with Water-neutral switches. Metagross Steel moves are severely NVE (0.25x) into Water/Steel Empoleon. Mamoswine EQ is primary Empoleon removal tool but requires safe switch-in. Hatterene TR enables slow sweepers. Preserve Mega Metagross for Mega Gengar Shadow Tag matchup. Opponent Tailwind single-use already expended with Aerodactyl KO.

decisions.rationale: +2 Modest Empoleon Hydro Pump guarantees an OHKO on Incineroar if it connects. If Incineroar uses Fake Out on Aerodactyl, Incineroar is deleted immediately on turn 1. If Incineroar Fake Out hits Empoleon, Aerodactyl sets Tailwind unimpeded, establishing Speed control for the backline.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent confirmed moves/items: Mega Metagross (Protect, Ice Punch, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch), Incineroar (Fake Out, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz; Sitrus Berry), Rotom-Heat (Levitate, Leftovers, Thunderbolt, Overheat, Will-O-Wisp, Protect), Mamoswine (Life Orb, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Rock Slide, Protect).
Strategic facts: Empoleon quad-resists Mega Metagross's Steel/Ice attacks and activates Competitive against Incineroar (+2 SpA Hydro Pump OHKOs Incineroar).
Plan: Intended Mega is Gengar. Lead Empoleon + Aerodactyl to punish Incineroar leads and set Tailwind, cleanup with Mega Gengar + Dragonite.

decisions.rationale: Gengar is our designated Mega Evolution and naturally outspeeds Adamant Mega Metagross (178 vs max 162). Mega Gengar's Shadow Tag will trap Metagross and prospective switches, while threatening super-effective Shadow Ball or Will-O-Wisp burns. Dragonite would take heavy damage from Metagross's Ice Punch and Mamoswine's Ice Shard, making Gengar the superior entry.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent confirmed moves/items: Mega Metagross (Protect, Ice Punch, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch), Incineroar (Fake Out, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz; Sitrus Berry), Rotom-Heat (Levitate, Leftovers, Thunderbolt, Overheat, Will-O-Wisp, Protect), Mamoswine (Life Orb, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Rock Slide, Protect).
Strategic facts: Empoleon quad-resists Mega Metagross's Steel/Ice moves and remains at 100% HP with +2 SpA. Gengar naturally outspeeds Adamant Mega Metagross (178 Speed vs max 162).
Plan: Mega Evolve Gengar to lock in Metagross with Shadow Tag, apply Shadow Ball/Will-O-Wisp pressure alongside +2 SpA Empoleon.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Gengar with Psychic (91.6-214.8%) + Meteor Mash (51.5-126.7%) guarantees KO regardless of damage rolls, preventing Mega Gengar Shadow Tag trap. Gengar moves first (143-178 Spe) and hits Hatterene for 31-54% with Shadow Ball, but Hatterene survives. Empoleon's attacks on Metagross are minimal (Flash Cannon 7-14%). Preserves Mega Evolution for later.
decisions.notebook: Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA is major threat - respect with Water-neutral switches. Gengar must be KO'd before it can Mega Evolve; double-targeting with Psychic+Meteor Mash guarantees this. Metagross Steel moves are 0.25x into Empoleon (Water/Steel) - avoid targeting it. Mamoswine EQ is primary Empoleon removal but requires safe switch-in. Hatterene TR enables slow sweepers but only use when Gengar threat is neutralized. Preserve Mega Metagross for Mega Gengar Shadow Tag matchup. Opponent Tailwind already expended.

decisions.rationale: Down to last mon Mamoswine. Must be aggressive. Earthquake into Gengar-Mega deals 82.6-284.4% (likely OHKO), removing the faster threat. If Gengar falls, Mamoswine outspeeds Empoleon (120 vs 80-112) and can EQ next turn (69-225% single-target). Hydro Pump has 80% accuracy - 20% miss chance gives me a free turn. Shadow Ball alone maxes at 97.8%, can't OHKO. Passing slot 2 since only one mon remains.
decisions.notebook: Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA Hydro Pump is primary threat but 80% accuracy creates variance. Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball cannot OHKO Mamoswine alone. Mamoswine EQ single-target removes spread reduction, significantly boosting KO chances. When down to last mon, aggressive targeting of faster threat (Gengar) is optimal - if KO'd, speed advantage vs Empoleon enables cleanup. Preserve Life Orb for maximum damage output. Opponent may Protect to scout when ahead.

decisions.rationale: Empoleon (80 Speed) naturally outspeeds Hatterene (44-72 Speed), allowing its +2 SpA Flash Cannon to guaranteed OHKO Hatterene before Trick Room or Psychic. Gengar (178 Speed) outspeeds Mega Metagross (max 162 Speed); Mega Evolving traps the foes with Shadow Tag while Shadow Ball chunks or OHKOs Metagross.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent confirmed moves/items: Mega Metagross (Protect, Ice Punch, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch), Incineroar (Fake Out, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz; Sitrus Berry), Rotom-Heat (Levitate, Leftovers, Thunderbolt, Overheat, Will-O-Wisp, Protect), Mamoswine (Life Orb, Earthquake, Ice Shard, Rock Slide, Protect).
Strategic facts: Empoleon quad-resists Mega Metagross's Steel/Ice moves and remains at 100% HP with +2 SpA. Gengar naturally outspeeds Adamant Mega Metagross (178 Speed vs max 162). Empoleon (80 Speed) outspeeds Hatterene (44-72 Speed).
Plan: Mega Evolve Gengar to lock in Metagross with Shadow Tag. Empoleon KOes Hatterene with +2 Flash Cannon; Gengar pressures Metagross with Shadow Ball.

decisions.rationale: Down to last Pokémon, must maximize KO potential. Earthquake is SE on both foes (2x each). Even with 0.75x spread reduction, damage ranges (91-213% Gengar, 76-169% Empoleon) give strong OHKO chances on at least one target. Gengar moves first but its attacks are neutral/NVE; Empoleon is slower. KOing Gengar first gives speed advantage vs Empoleon next turn. Ice Shard lacks power, Protect wastes crucial turn.
decisions.notebook: Empoleon Competitive +2 SpA Hydro Pump primary threat (80% acc variance). Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball neutral vs Mamoswine, cannot OHKO alone. When down to last mon, prioritize KOing faster threat (Gengar) to gain speed advantage vs Empoleon. Opponent tends to Protect when ahead to scout. Mamoswine Earthquake SE on Gengar-Mega/Empoleon but spread reduction (0.75x) limits OHKO consistency in doubles; single-target moves avoid penalty. Preserve Life Orb for maximum damage output.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine is the opponent's final Pokémon. Gengar-Mega (200 Speed) outspeeds Mamoswine (100-132 Speed) and chunk-damages it with Shadow Ball before Mamoswine can move. Empoleon follow-ups with 100% accurate +2 SpA Flash Cannon to guarantee the KO and secure the series win. Even if Mamoswine uses +1 Ice Shard, Life Orb Ice Shard cannot OHKO either full-HP partner.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Incineroar, Mega Metagross, Hatterene, Mamoswine (LO, EQ/Ice Shard/Rock Slide/Protect), Rotom-H, Meowscarada.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite is our last Pokémon and full health with Multiscale intact. Mamoswine is at 22% HP. Dragonite is immune to Earthquake and Multiscale allows it to easily survive a Life Orb Ice Shard (53-75% damage max). Furthermore, Extreme Speed (+2 priority) outspeeds Ice Shard (+1 priority) to secure or setup the final KO.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 won by p1. Opponent team: Incineroar, Mega Metagross, Hatterene, Mamoswine (LO, EQ/Ice Shard/Rock Slide/Protect), Rotom-H, Meowscarada.

decisions.rationale: Protect first: Dragonite's ExtremeSpeed (+2) always outruns Ice Shard (+1). Protecting breaks Multiscale if Dragonite attacks, and Ice Shard next turn does 75.3-168.7% without Multiscale vs 37.6-84.3% with it. Mamoswine at 22% HP risks being KOed by ExtremeSpeed (13.4-43.8%) if attacking immediately. Protect is safer and sets up a much more reliable KO.
decisions.notebook: Multiscale halves damage at full HP - must break it before committing to Ice Shard. ExtremeSpeed +2 priority always beats Ice Shard +1. Life Orb Mamoswine Ice Shard without Multiscale: 75-169% vs Dragonite. Preserve Mamoswine as last mon vs Dragonite; Protect then attack is optimal sequence. Opponent may Protect to scout when ahead.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite's Extreme Speed has +2 priority, outspeeding Mamoswine's +1 Ice Shard. At 22% HP, Mamoswine is within range of Extreme Speed (21.7–39.5%). Even if Extreme Speed rolls minimum damage, Multiscale reduces Ice Shard to 44.4–62.9%, ensuring Dragonite survives and wins.

Mamoswine is my last Pokémon vs Dragonite. Ice Shard (+1) is super-effective 4x; with Multiscale halving damage at 100% HP, the 75-169% range becomes 37.5-84.5%. If it breaks Multiscale and rolls high, it KOs. Protect has reduced success rate after use on T4, and if it fails, Mamoswine dies to Extreme Speed (+2 always beats +1). Attacking now is the highest-EV line - even if Dragonite Protects, I preserve the option to attack next turn. Rock Slide lacks priority and loses to Extreme Speed.
decisions.notebook: Multiscale halves damage at full HP - must break before Ice Shard can reliably KO. Extreme Speed +2 priority always beats Ice Shard +1. Life Orb Mamoswine Ice Shard without Multiscale: 75-169% vs Dragonite. Protect success rate drops after consecutive use. When ahead 1-0 in series, preserve last mon advantage; avoid giving free turns. Opponent may Protect to scout when ahead. Dragonite Lum Berry can cure status but won't help vs Ice Shard.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite's Multiscale is active at 100% HP, cutting Mamoswine's Life Orb Ice Shard to max 75% damage (53-75%). Dragon Claw (+0 priority, 100% acc) deals 32.7-58.9% which is a 100% guaranteed KO against Mamoswine's 22% HP. Extreme Speed (+2 priority) has a slight risk of leaving Mamoswine at 1 HP on the lowest damage roll (21.7%). Dragon Claw guarantees game 2 and the series win.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 won by p1. Game 2 won by p1 (2-0).

reflections.summary: The selected four and intended Mega Metagross were fundamentally mismatched against the opponent’s core: Mega Gengar hard-countered Metagross, Competitive Empoleon OHKOed Incineroar, and Flash Cannon OHKOed Hatterene. This preview flaw caused a rapid 3-for-2 deficit, isolating Mamoswine against a full-HP Multiscale Dragonite that survived Ice Shard and secured the win.
reflections.adjustment: Change the lead to avoid Incineroar into Competitive Empoleon; replace Hatterene with a faster pivot or a dedicated Dragonite check, and ensure a reliable Multiscale-breaking strategy (status, entry hazards, or stronger priority) is prioritized in team preview.
reflections.notebook: Opponent favors Aerodactyl + Competitive Empoleon leads to trigger SpA boosts and control speed. Mega Gengar is deployed as a fast special sweeper that hard-counters Steel/Psychic types. Competitive Empoleon Hydro Pump reliably OHKOes Incineroar; Modest Flash Cannon OHKOes Hatterene. Dragonite relies on intact Multiscale + Lum Berry to survive priority and pivot into Dragon Claw. Future plan: Avoid Incineroar into Competitive Empoleon; lead with a faster pivot or a mon that safely handles Gengar/Empoleon; bring a dedicated Multiscale-breaker or stronger priority user to handle Dragonite.

reflections.summary: Leading Empoleon into Incineroar successfully punished Intimidate with a +2 SpA Competitive boost, yielding a turn-1 knockout and creating fast offensive momentum for Mega Gengar and Dragonite to clean up Metagross, Hatterene, and Mamoswine.
reflections.adjustment: Re-use the Empoleon lead to exploit Incineroar if opponent keeps the same lead, but use Protect or Wide Guard on Aerodactyl Turn 1 to preserve its Focus Sash instead of taking a turn-1 knockout.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tends to lead Incineroar + Metagross to apply Fake Out and physical pressure. Empoleon punishes Incineroar's Intimidate via Competitive (+2 SpA). Opponent Mamoswine carries Life Orb with Ice Shard and Earthquake. Opponent Hatterene holds Mental Herb.
